story.title: Nüwa
story.text: The Yan Emperor's youngest daughter went to play by the Eastern Sea.
story.narration: The Yan Emperor had a youngest daughter called Nüwa. One day she went to play by the Eastern Sea.

story.title: A Little Bird
story.text: She became a little bird and carried stones to fill the sea.
story.narration: Nüwa never came home again. She became a little bird called Jingwei, and from that day on she carried small stones to drop into the Eastern Sea.

keyMoment.question: The sea is so big — can one little bird ever fill it?

options.text: It can't be done, so give up
It can't be done, but carry one stone at a time anyway

keyMoment.reveal: She knew it would never be full, and still she never once stopped.

misconceptions: If you can't finish it, don't start
A hopeless task is not worth doing

quiz.question: Who was Jingwei before?
options: Nüwa, the Yan Emperor's youngest daughter
quiz.explanation: Nüwa met her end by the Eastern Sea and became a little bird called Jingwei.

quiz.question: What does Jingwei do every day?
options: Carries stones and twigs and drops them into the sea
quiz.explanation: Trip after trip, she carries wood and stone to fill the Eastern Sea.

quiz.question: Which of these is most like Jingwei filling the sea?
options: Practising ten characters a day until your writing is good
Writing a thousand characters in one day
quiz.explanation: A little at a time looks slow, but it keeps moving forward.
